title: Climbing and crawling
description: In the Tutorial, the Spelunker jumps onto a ladder and climbs it, then jumps off to the left and opens a chest. Ducking, he crawls over the edge of a step, flips round to hang from it, lets go, and walks off the steps into a fall that stuns him.
